sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/AuK: AuK: An Open-Source Foundational Model ...
sources.snippet: AuK is a 1.5B foundation model for speech generation and editing. Trained on millions of hours of diverse audio data, AuK supports zero-shot and instruction-based TTS, content and acoustic editing, paralinguistic editing, speech enhancement, and source separation through a unified natural-language instruction interface. sources.title: GitHub - vanch007/mlx-AuK: AuK: Native Apple Silicon MLX Port for 1.5B ...
sources.snippet: MLX-AuK is the native Apple Silicon port of Tencent-Hunyuan/AuK (arXiv:2609.08936), an all-in-one 1.5B speech foundation model capable of zero-shot text-to-speech, speech editing, paralinguistic modification, enhancement, and voice separation through unified natural language instructions.
